causes/acceleration-too-high.label: Acceleration or corner velocity too high
causes/acceleration-too-high.description: High accelerations excite resonances, cause bulging at corners and can skip steps.
causes/acceleration-too-high.check: Print at lower acceleration (or run TEST_SPEED); ringing, bulges or shifts shrink.

causes/adhesion-too-strong.label: Adhesion too strong
causes/adhesion-too-strong.description: Large contact areas, glue build-up or materials like PETG on smooth PEI bond too well.
causes/adhesion-too-strong.check: The part releases only after full cooling or with a release agent.

causes/bed-not-level-or-unmeshed.label: Bed not level or mesh missing
causes/bed-not-level-or-unmeshed.description: Nozzle height varies across the bed when the gantry is racked or no heat-soaked mesh is used.
causes/bed-not-level-or-unmeshed.check: Squish patches across the bed differ; PROBE_ACCURACY and mesh range show it.

causes/bed-temp-too-high.label: Bed temperature too high
causes/bed-temp-too-high.description: Lower layers stay soft and sag under the weight of the part.
causes/bed-temp-too-high.check: Bottom flare shrinks with a cooler bed (5 °C steps as a starting value).

causes/bed-temp-too-low.label: Bed temperature too low
causes/bed-temp-too-low.description: The first layer does not stay soft enough to bond and contracts early.
causes/bed-temp-too-low.check: Adhesion improves with a hotter bed (5–10 °C steps as a starting value, within the material window).

causes/belt-or-pulley-artifacts.label: Belt or pulley tooth artifacts
causes/belt-or-pulley-artifacts.description: Belt, pulley or idler teeth print as fine vertical lines at about the tooth pitch (≈2 mm).
causes/belt-or-pulley-artifacts.check: Measure artifact spacing on the wall; ≈2 mm points to belt-path parts.

causes/bridge-flow-or-speed-wrong.label: Bridge flow or speed wrong
causes/bridge-flow-or-speed-wrong.description: Bridge flow above 100 % sags and bulges the layers above; too fast bridges droop.
causes/bridge-flow-or-speed-wrong.check: Problems only above bridges; preview shows bridge detection and direction.

causes/brittle-filament.label: Brittle filament snaps
causes/brittle-filament.description: Old, sun-exposed or cheap filament becomes brittle and snaps in the feed path, often unseen in a Bowden tube.
causes/brittle-filament.check: Filament breaks when bent by hand; a fresh spool feeds fine.

causes/chamber-too-cold.label: Chamber too cold for the material
causes/chamber-too-cold.description: Shrinking materials (ABS, ASA, PC, PA) build stress against a cool chamber and lift or crack.
causes/chamber-too-cold.check: Warping drops with an enclosed, heat-soaked chamber.

causes/chamber-too-hot-for-material.label: Chamber too hot for the material
causes/chamber-too-hot-for-material.description: Low-temperature materials like PLA soften and heat-creep in a closed, warm chamber.
causes/chamber-too-hot-for-material.check: Problems disappear with doors open or panels removed.

causes/contaminated-build-surface.label: Contaminated build surface
causes/contaminated-build-surface.description: Skin oils and residue block adhesion.
causes/contaminated-build-surface.check: Adhesion returns after washing with dish soap and water.

causes/elephant-foot-compensation-missin.label: No elephant-foot compensation
causes/elephant-foot-compensation-missin.description: Some first-layer flare is inherent; without compensation the bottom stays wider than the wall.
causes/elephant-foot-compensation-missin.check: Bottom edge wider than the wall even with correct squish.

causes/elephant-foot-compensation-too-hi.label: Elephant-foot compensation too high
causes/elephant-foot-compensation-too-hi.check: Perimeter gaps only in the lowest layers.

causes/em-too-high.label: Extrusion multiplier too high
causes/em-too-high.description: More plastic than the line volume: ridged top surfaces, oversize parts, pushed-out perimeters and extra ooze.
causes/em-too-high.check: Print the EM cubes; top surfaces become smooth and dimensions correct at a lower value.

causes/em-too-low.label: Extrusion multiplier too low
causes/em-too-low.description: Less plastic than the line volume: gaps between lines, thin walls and weak bonding everywhere at all speeds.
causes/em-too-low.check: EM cubes: gaps close at a higher value; the defect does not depend on speed.

causes/excessive-cooling.label: Too much part cooling
causes/excessive-cooling.description: Strong cooling freezes the line before it fuses: weak layers, perimeter separation and warping in shrinking materials.
causes/excessive-cooling.check: Lower fan and compare bonding or warping on identical geometry.

causes/external-perimeter-too-narrow.label: External perimeter too narrow
causes/external-perimeter-too-narrow.description: With layer heights above about half the nozzle size, a narrow outer line cannot reach the neighbouring perimeter.
causes/external-perimeter-too-narrow.check: Gaps between outer and inner wall everywhere; layer height > 50 % of the nozzle.

causes/extruder-gear-backlash-or-wear.label: Extruder gear backlash, play or wear
causes/extruder-gear-backlash-or-wear.description: A dead zone on reversal or worn/eccentric gears makes extrusion uneven: repeating texture, inconsistent PA and stringing.
causes/extruder-gear-backlash-or-wear.check: Mark the gears and watch reversals; inspect teeth; wood-grain texture with a fixed period points here.

causes/extruder-motor-current.label: Extruder motor current wrong
causes/extruder-motor-current.description: Too little current loses steps under load; too much overheats the motor and softens the filament.
causes/extruder-motor-current.check: Compare configured run_current with the motor rating (Klipper: keep ≤ 50–60 % of rated as a starting point).

causes/extruder-not-calibrated.label: Extruder not calibrated
causes/extruder-not-calibrated.description: The extruder moves a different length than commanded, so every flow value is scaled wrong.
causes/extruder-not-calibrated.check: Mark and extrude 100 mm slowly; measure the actual length.

causes/extruder-not-primed.label: Extruder not primed
causes/extruder-not-primed.description: During heat-up the nozzle oozes empty, so the first moves extrude nothing until pressure rebuilds.
causes/extruder-not-primed.check: Extrusion starts a few seconds late or only after the skirt.

causes/filament-tension-or-drag.label: Filament tension or path drag
causes/filament-tension-or-drag.description: Too much or too little idler tension, a tangled or binding spool or a tight PTFE path makes feeding inconsistent.
causes/filament-tension-or-drag.check: Pull the filament by hand through the path; check spool rotation and idler marks on the filament.

causes/first-layer-lines-too-thin.label: First-layer lines too thin
causes/first-layer-lines-too-thin.description: Narrow first-layer lines have little contact area.
causes/first-layer-lines-too-thin.check: Adhesion improves with a wider first layer.

causes/first-layer-too-fast.label: First layer printed too fast
causes/first-layer-too-fast.description: A fast first layer gets too little time to bond to the build surface.
causes/first-layer-too-fast.check: Adhesion improves when the first layer runs at about half speed.

causes/frame-thermal-drift.label: Frame thermal drift
causes/frame-thermal-drift.description: Frame and gantry expand during the first hour of chamber heating and shift Z.
causes/frame-thermal-drift.check: First layer differs between cold and heat-soaked starts.

causes/heat-creep.label: Heat creep
causes/heat-creep.description: Heat rises past the heatbreak, filament softens early and jams; typical for PLA in a warm enclosure or a weak hotend fan.
causes/heat-creep.check: Jams appear after some time printing and in warm chambers; hotend fan below 100 % or chamber hot.

causes/infill-line-too-thin.label: Infill lines too thin
causes/infill-line-too-thin.description: Thin infill lines make weak infill walls; wider lines are stronger at the same density.
causes/infill-line-too-thin.check: Infill strength improves with a wider infill extrusion width.

causes/infill-overlap-wrong.label: Infill/perimeter overlap wrong
causes/infill-overlap-wrong.description: Too much overlap pushes walls out; too little leaves pinholes where infill meets perimeters.
causes/infill-overlap-wrong.check: Pinholes or bulges exactly at the infill/perimeter boundary after EM and PA are tuned.

causes/infill-too-fast.label: Infill printed too fast
causes/infill-too-fast.description: Infill usually runs fastest; when the extruder cannot keep up it under-extrudes and fails to bond.
causes/infill-too-fast.check: Infill becomes solid at about half the speed.

causes/infill-too-sparse.label: Infill too sparse
causes/infill-too-sparse.description: Low infill density leaves wide air gaps for top layers and corners to span.
causes/infill-too-sparse.check: Top gaps shrink when infill density rises (e.g. 30 % → 50 %).

causes/insufficient-cooling.label: Insufficient part cooling
causes/insufficient-cooling.description: Plastic stays soft: sagging bridges, curled overhangs, melted small features.
causes/insufficient-cooling.check: Compare with higher fan and a cooler ambient; problems concentrate on small or overhanging features.

causes/layer-height-too-large.label: Layer height too large for the nozzle
causes/layer-height-too-large.description: Each layer must be pressed onto the one below; above about 80 % of the nozzle diameter it is not.
causes/layer-height-too-large.check: Layer separation disappears with layer height ≤ ~80 % of nozzle diameter.

causes/layer-height-too-small.label: Layer height too small
causes/layer-height-too-small.description: A tiny gap under the nozzle restricts flow and makes extrusion uneven.
causes/layer-height-too-small.check: Extrusion evens out at a more typical layer height.

causes/layer-time-too-short.label: Layer time too short
causes/layer-time-too-short.description: Small layers are printed before the previous one has solidified.
causes/layer-time-too-short.check: Defects only on small cross-sections or tips; printing several parts at once helps.

causes/load-along-layer-lines.label: Load along layer lines (orientation)
causes/load-along-layer-lines.description: FDM parts are weakest across layers; loads that pull layers apart fail regardless of tuning.
causes/load-along-layer-lines.check: Fracture follows one layer plane; strength changes with orientation.

causes/loose-mechanics.label: Loose belts, pulleys or toolhead parts
causes/loose-mechanics.description: Slack belts, loose pulley grub screws or loose toolhead parts let the toolhead lag or slip.
causes/loose-mechanics.check: Check belt tension by frequency, pulley set screws and wobble on the toolhead by hand.

causes/material-shrinkage.label: Material shrinkage stress
causes/material-shrinkage.description: Cooling plastic contracts; in high-shrink materials the stress beats bed adhesion at sharp corners.
causes/material-shrinkage.check: Lifting starts at sharp corners and grows with part size.

causes/missing-supports.label: Unsupported overhang or bridge
causes/missing-supports.description: Overhangs and long bridges beyond the printer's ability need support or redesign.
causes/missing-supports.check: Failure only on steep overhangs or long spans.

causes/no-z-hop.label: No z-hop over printed surfaces
causes/no-z-hop.description: Without a small lift the nozzle drags across finished top layers during travel.
causes/no-z-hop.check: Scars follow travel paths over top surfaces.

causes/non-manifold-mesh.label: Broken (non-manifold) model
causes/non-manifold-mesh.description: Intersecting or open meshes slice into missing or wrong regions.
causes/non-manifold-mesh.check: The slicer warns about errors, or the layer preview differs from the model.

causes/nozzle-strike-on-curled-part.label: Nozzle hits curled print
causes/nozzle-strike-on-curled-part.description: Curled overhangs or warped corners catch the nozzle, knocking the toolhead or part.
causes/nozzle-strike-on-curled-part.check: Shift happens at a layer with curling; scuff marks on the part.

causes/nozzle-temp-too-high.label: Nozzle temperature too high
causes/nozzle-temp-too-high.description: Low melt viscosity lets plastic ooze during travel and small features stay soft.
causes/nozzle-temp-too-high.check: Print a temperature tower; stringing or sagging that improves at lower steps confirms it.

causes/nozzle-temp-too-low.label: Nozzle temperature too low
causes/nozzle-temp-too-low.description: Plastic that is too cold flows poorly and bonds weakly to the previous layer or perimeter; at high flow it can make the extruder skip.
causes/nozzle-temp-too-low.check: Raise temperature in 5–10 °C steps (starting value) with everything else fixed; better bonding or fewer skips confirm it.

causes/nozzle-too-large-for-detail.label: Nozzle too large for the detail
causes/nozzle-too-large-for-detail.description: Features smaller than the nozzle cannot be reproduced in XY.
causes/nozzle-too-large-for-detail.check: Missing features are thinner than the nozzle diameter.

causes/nozzle-worn-or-leaking.label: Worn, dirty or leaking nozzle
causes/nozzle-worn-or-leaking.description: A worn bore, debris or a nozzle that is not hot-tightened changes flow and leaks plastic.
causes/nozzle-worn-or-leaking.check: Inspect the tip and the nozzle threads for plastic; compare with a new nozzle.

causes/out-of-filament.label: Out of filament
causes/out-of-filament.description: The spool ran out or the filament end left the extruder.
causes/out-of-filament.check: Check the spool and the filament path to the nozzle.

causes/overhang-too-fast.label: Overhangs printed too fast
causes/overhang-too-fast.description: Fast overhangs do not get enough time to cool.
causes/overhang-too-fast.check: Overhang quality improves with dynamic overhang speeds.

causes/pa-smooth-time-too-high.label: Pressure advance smoothing too long
causes/pa-smooth-time-too-high.description: Klipper smooths PA over a time window; on short top-infill segments a long window leaves excess pressure.
causes/pa-smooth-time-too-high.check: Lower pressure_advance_smooth_time (then re-test PA) and compare small top islands.

causes/pa-too-high.label: Pressure advance too high
causes/pa-too-high.description: Pressure is pulled too early: gaps at line starts, thin corners and under-extruded starts.
causes/pa-too-high.check: PA tower: line starts recover at a lower value.

causes/pa-too-low.label: Pressure advance too low
causes/pa-too-low.description: Nozzle pressure lags the toolhead: corners bulge, line ends blob and residual pressure oozes on travel.
causes/pa-too-low.check: Print a PA tower or pattern; sharper corners at a higher value confirm it.

causes/partial-clog.label: Partial clog
causes/partial-clog.description: A restricted nozzle or heatbreak limits flow; the extruder skips and extrusion is thin or stops.
causes/partial-clog.check: Manual extrusion at temperature is weak or deflected; a cold pull pulls debris.

causes/perimeter-order.label: Perimeter order pushes walls out
causes/perimeter-order.description: Printing inner walls first lets them push the outer wall outward.
causes/perimeter-order.check: Bulges near features; improves with external perimeters first (can hurt extreme overhangs).

causes/poor-filament-quality.label: Poor or degraded filament
causes/poor-filament-quality.description: Diameter variation, additives or aged material change the extruded volume from layer to layer.
causes/poor-filament-quality.check: Measure diameter along the spool; compare with a fresh high-quality spool.

causes/print-speed-too-high.label: Print speed too high
causes/print-speed-too-high.description: High feature speeds raise flow demand, vibration and bonding time pressure.
causes/print-speed-too-high.check: Print the same part at reduced speed; the defect shrinks.

causes/resonance-uncompensated.label: Resonance not compensated
causes/resonance-uncompensated.description: Frame and toolhead resonances echo after sharp features when input shaping is missing or stale.
causes/resonance-uncompensated.check: Ripples decay after corners with a spacing that changes with speed; measure with an accelerometer.

causes/retraction-excessive.label: Retraction too long or too fast
causes/retraction-excessive.description: Long or fast retractions grind filament, pull molten plastic into the cold zone and jam soft filaments like TPU.
causes/retraction-excessive.check: Clicking or chewed filament near the drive gear after many retractions; problem shrinks with shorter retraction.

causes/retraction-insufficient.label: Retraction too short or too slow
causes/retraction-insufficient.description: Pressure is not relieved before travel, so the nozzle oozes between islands.
causes/retraction-insufficient.check: Retraction test: strings shrink as length/speed increase (after PA, EM, temperature and moisture are ruled out).

causes/seam-random.label: Random seam placement
causes/seam-random.description: Each layer starts at a new spot, leaving start/stop pits all over the walls.
causes/seam-random.check: Pits scattered on walls, not on one line.

causes/seam-start-stop-pressure.label: Seam start/stop pressure
causes/seam-start-stop-pressure.description: Pressure at loop starts and ends leaves a zit; extra restart or no wipe makes it worse.
causes/seam-start-stop-pressure.check: Observe one perimeter: the blob is at the start or the end of the loop.

causes/sheet-not-seated.label: Sheet not seated flat
causes/sheet-not-seated.description: Debris under the flex sheet creates a local bump.
causes/sheet-not-seated.check: A local high spot that moves with the sheet.

causes/shrinkage-uncompensated.label: Shrinkage not compensated
causes/shrinkage-uncompensated.description: Constant errors need an XY offset; errors that grow with part size are shrinkage and need scaling.
causes/shrinkage-uncompensated.check: Measure a small and a large part: same error = offset, proportional error = shrinkage.

causes/small-contact-area.label: Small contact area
causes/small-contact-area.description: Small or sharp-cornered footprints have too little area to resist lifting forces.
causes/small-contact-area.check: Lifting starts at corners or thin feet.

causes/small-island-geometry.label: Small top islands (inherent)
causes/small-island-geometry.description: Short top-infill segments always look slightly overextruded; partly normal.
causes/small-island-geometry.check: Only small islands look rough while wide areas are fine: judge EM on wide areas.

causes/stepper-driver-or-wiring.label: Stepper driver or wiring fault
causes/stepper-driver-or-wiring.description: Intermittent wiring, poor crimps or overheating drivers lose steps on motion axes or the extruder.
causes/stepper-driver-or-wiring.check: Mark the motor shaft: shuddering points to wiring, no movement to electrics or driver heat.

causes/stepper-driver-tuning.label: Stepper driver tuning artifacts
causes/stepper-driver-tuning.description: Driver chopper settings can add fine periodic wall artifacts on X/Y. Community values are experimental.
causes/stepper-driver-tuning.check: Artifacts only on one motion pair and unchanged by belts/bearings.

causes/support-interface-settings.label: Support interface or gap wrong
causes/support-interface-settings.description: Too little gap welds supports to the part; too much or too sparse a top lets the surface droop.
causes/support-interface-settings.check: The underside is either torn on removal or droopy; vary one support setting at a time.

causes/support-too-weak.label: Supports too weak
causes/support-too-weak.description: Sparse or tall supports wobble, crack or detach mid-print.
causes/support-too-weak.check: Supports look uneven or stringy before the overhang reaches them.

causes/temperature-fluctuation.label: Hotend temperature fluctuation
causes/temperature-fluctuation.description: A poorly tuned PID loop swings the nozzle temperature cyclically, changing flow layer by layer.
causes/temperature-fluctuation.check: Temperature graph varies by more than about ±2 °C during printing.

causes/too-few-perimeters.label: Too few perimeters
causes/too-few-perimeters.description: Thin shells let infill show through and give step-downs a weak foundation.

causes/too-many-retractions.label: Unnecessary retractions
causes/too-many-retractions.description: Every retract/prime cycle risks a zit; retracting on moves that never cross open space adds defects for nothing.
causes/too-many-retractions.check: Zits sit at travel starts inside a single island.

causes/top-layers-insufficient.label: Too few top solid layers
causes/top-layers-insufficient.description: Top solid layers must bridge the infill gaps; a thin top sags into them.
causes/top-layers-insufficient.check: Gaps disappear with more top layers (aim for a top shell of at least ~0.5 mm as a starting point).

causes/travel-over-open-space.label: Travel crosses open air
causes/travel-over-open-space.description: Every travel over empty space is a chance to ooze. Avoiding it only works inside one island; between separate islands the nozzle must cross air.
causes/travel-over-open-space.check: Strings only where travel crosses holes or gaps; compare a preview with avoid crossing perimeters on.

causes/travel-too-slow.label: Travel moves too slow
causes/travel-too-slow.description: Slow travel gives the nozzle more time to ooze over open space.
causes/travel-too-slow.check: Stringing drops when travel speed rises (if the machine can handle it).

causes/unsuitable-build-surface.label: Unsuitable build surface
causes/unsuitable-build-surface.description: Fake or worn PEI, the wrong side of the sheet or a surface that does not suit the material.
causes/unsuitable-build-surface.check: Compare on a known-good genuine sheet.

causes/volumetric-flow-exceeded.label: Volumetric flow above the hotend limit
causes/volumetric-flow-exceeded.description: Speed asks for more mm³/s than the hotend can melt: under-extrusion on fast sections, skipping and weak layers.
causes/volumetric-flow-exceeded.check: Defect only on fast sections or high line widths; disappears when slowed down.

causes/wall-thinner-than-line-width.label: Wall thinner than the extrusion width
causes/wall-thinner-than-line-width.description: Walls only a few line widths thick leave gaps, or vanish below one line width.
causes/wall-thinner-than-line-width.check: Preview shows gaps or missing thin features.

causes/wet-filament.label: Wet filament
causes/wet-filament.description: Absorbed water boils in the nozzle: popping, steam, ooze, rough walls and weak layers. Common with PETG, nylon, TPU and PC; new spools can be wet too.
causes/wet-filament.check: Extrude into air: popping, hissing or steam bubbles confirm it. Print the same part from a freshly dried spool and compare.

causes/worn-or-binding-motion-parts.label: Binding or worn bearings, rails or motors
causes/worn-or-binding-motion-parts.description: Rough bearings, rails or motors add periodic artifacts and resistance that can skip steps.
causes/worn-or-binding-motion-parts.check: Move each axis by hand with motors off; print square samples aligned and at 45° to isolate the axis.

causes/wrong-filament-diameter.label: Wrong filament diameter setting
causes/wrong-filament-diameter.description: The slicer computes volume from the configured diameter; a mismatch scales all extrusion.
causes/wrong-filament-diameter.check: Measure the filament with calipers at several points and compare with the profile.

causes/z-offset-too-high.label: Nozzle too far from the bed
causes/z-offset-too-high.description: First-layer lines are round and barely touch: poor adhesion, gaps in the second layer, separated bottom perimeters.
causes/z-offset-too-high.check: Inspect first-layer patches: gaps between lines, rounded tops.

causes/z-offset-too-low.label: Nozzle too close to the bed
altLabel: nozzle too close to print bed
causes/z-offset-too-low.description: Over-squished first layer: flare, rough surface, the extruder struggles on the first layer.
causes/z-offset-too-low.check: First-layer patches are translucent or ridged; skipping only on the first layer.

causes/zhop-too-high.label: Z-hop too high
causes/zhop-too-high.description: A high lift gives the nozzle time and height to drag a string on every travel.
causes/zhop-too-high.check: Strings appear mainly at travel starts; they shrink with z-hop at 0.2–0.3 mm or off.

defects/bulging.label: Bulging
defects/bulging.description: Plastic pushed outward from perimeters — layers, sharp corners, around features, above overhangs.

defects/dimensional-inaccuracy.label: Dimensional inaccuracy
defects/dimensional-inaccuracy.description: Printed parts are larger or smaller than designed.

defects/elephant-foot.label: Elephant foot
defects/elephant-foot.description: Bottom layers flare outward beyond the wall line.

defects/extruder-skipping.label: Extruder skipping / clicking
defects/extruder-skipping.description: Wide periodic gaps, clicking extruder; clogs, heat creep, tension, flow above limit, current.

defects/extrusion-patterns.label: Extrusion patterns ("wood grain")
defects/extrusion-patterns.description: Repeating innie-outie texture along lines, often from extruder gear backlash.

defects/extrusion-stops.label: Extrusion stops mid-print
defects/extrusion-stops.description: The print continues moving but no plastic comes out.

defects/first-layer-inconsistency.label: First layer inconsistency
defects/first-layer-inconsistency.description: Squish varies across the bed or between prints.

defects/inconsistent-extrusion.label: Inconsistent extrusion
defects/inconsistent-extrusion.description: Line width varies along a single straight extrusion.

defects/infill-visible-through-walls.label: Infill visible through walls
defects/infill-visible-through-walls.description: The infill pattern shows through the outer walls.

defects/infill-wall-gaps.label: Gaps between infill and walls
altLabel: gaps between infill and outer wall
defects/infill-wall-gaps.description: Infill does not fuse to the innermost perimeter.

defects/layer-shift.label: Layer shifting
defects/layer-shift.description: Horizontal offset between layers — belts, nozzle strikes on curled parts, current, drivers, too much accel.

defects/model-errors.label: Model errors (non-manifold geometry)
defects/model-errors.description: Sections are missing or the print differs from the model although the printer works.

defects/no-extrusion-at-start.label: No extrusion at print start
altLabel: not extruding at start of print
defects/no-extrusion-at-start.description: Nothing or too little comes out during the first moves or layers.

defects/over-extrusion.label: Over-extrusion
defects/over-extrusion.description: Rough/ridged top surfaces, blobby small areas, dimensional oversize, nozzle dragging through top layers.

defects/overheating.label: Overheating (esp. PLA in enclosures)
defects/overheating.description: Droopy/melted small features, curled overhangs, heat creep jams with PLA in a closed printer.

defects/part-stuck-to-bed.label: Print stuck to the bed
defects/part-stuck-to-bed.description: The finished part will not release from the build plate.

defects/perimeter-separation.label: Perimeter separation
defects/perimeter-separation.description: Walls not bonding to each other or layer below — lower layers (elephant foot comp) or everywhere (width, speed, temp).

defects/pockmarks.label: Pockmarks
defects/pockmarks.description: Small pits on walls — random seam, wet filament, bad nozzle.

defects/poor-bed-adhesion.label: Poor bed adhesion
defects/poor-bed-adhesion.description: Prints don't stick, corners lift, parts pop off mid-print.

defects/poor-layer-adhesion.label: Poor layer adhesion
defects/poor-layer-adhesion.description: Layers split under modest force because interlayer bonding is weaker than the applied load or because the process is inconsistent.

defects/ringing.label: Ringing / ghosting
defects/ringing.description: Echo ripples after sharp corners or features on walls.

defects/small-infill-overextruded.label: Small infill areas look overextruded
defects/small-infill-overextruded.description: Blobby short top-infill segments in small islands; partly normal.

defects/stringing.label: Stringing / oozing
defects/stringing.description: Thin strings or wisps between separate parts of a print. Usually moisture, temperature, PA or retraction — in that rough order.

defects/support-surface-quality.label: Poor surface above or below supports
defects/support-surface-quality.description: Surfaces resting on supports droop, or supports leave scars when removed.

defects/supports-fail.label: Supports fail during the print
defects/supports-fail.description: Support structures crack, wobble or detach before the overhang is printed.

defects/thin-walls-and-small-features.label: Thin walls and small features missing
defects/thin-walls-and-small-features.description: Thin walls get gaps in the middle or small features do not print.

defects/top-surface-gaps.label: Gaps or pillowing in top layers
defects/top-surface-gaps.description: Top surfaces show holes, bumps or gaps where solid layers sag into the infill.

defects/top-surface-scars.label: Scars on top surfaces
defects/top-surface-scars.description: Travel moves leave marks across top layers.

defects/under-extrusion.label: Under-extrusion
defects/under-extrusion.description: Gaps between lines, thin/weak walls, missing layers, holes in top surfaces.

defects/vfas.label: VFAs (vertical fine artifacts)
defects/vfas.description: Fine vertical lines on walls — belts/pulleys/idlers (2 mm spacing) or bearings/rails/motor drivers.

defects/warping.label: Warping / corner lifting
defects/warping.description: Corners curl up during print, mainly ABS/ASA/PC/nylon; shrinkage stress beats adhesion.

defects/weak-infill.label: Weak or messy infill
defects/weak-infill.description: Infill is stringy, incomplete or fails to support the surfaces above.

defects/z-banding.label: Lines or ridges on the sides (Z banding)
altLabel: lines on the side of print
defects/z-banding.description: Individual layers stand out as lines, often in a repeating pattern.

defects/zits-blobs.label: Zits, blobs & visible seam
defects/zits-blobs.description: Small bumps on walls, usually at layer starts/seams or retraction points.

firmware/klipper-current.label: Current Klipper calibration and compatibility notes
firmware/klipper-current.description: Klipper firmware state is versioned and authoritative for pressure advance, input shaping, extrusion calibration, retraction and motion limits.

firmware/klipper-operating-boundaries.label: Klipper operating boundaries
firmware/klipper-operating-boundaries.description: Keep Klipper motion, extrusion and calibration limits consistent with slicer output and distinguish firmware state from profile settings.

fundamentals/layer-height-extrusion-widt.label: Layer height and extrusion width
fundamentals/layer-height-extrusion-widt.description: Layer height and line width trade vertical detail, XY resolution, bonding, throughput and machine limits.

hardware/nozzle-selection.label: Nozzle selection
hardware/nozzle-selection.description: Select nozzle diameter, geometry and material for the required detail, throughput, wear resistance and polymer.

hardware/voron-thermal-mechanics.label: Voron thermal and motion mechanics
hardware/voron-thermal-mechanics.description: Voron calibration must account for model-specific gantry architecture, belt tension, heat soak, chamber temperature and Klipper procedures.

materials/asa-abs.label: ABS / ASA
materials/asa-abs.description: Needs enclosure & heat soak; warps; surprisingly high fan OK in a hot chamber.

materials/engineering-materials.label: Engineering materials and reinforced filaments
materials/engineering-materials.description: Engineering polymers and fiber-filled filaments require product-specific drying, thermal, nozzle and chamber conditions; datasheet values are test-condition values.

materials/filament-moisture.label: Filament drying and moisture
materials/filament-moisture.description: Moisture changes extrusion behavior and surface quality; drying must follow the polymer and product's validated limits.

materials/nylon.label: Nylon (PA)
materials/nylon.description: Extremely hygroscopic, warps, needs dry box during printing.

materials/pc-cf.label: PC / PC-CF
materials/pc-cf.description: High temp, abrasive (CF → hardened nozzle), enclosure, warps; temperature trades stringing against surface and layer bonding; brand-specific EM.

materials/petg.label: PETG
materials/petg.description: Stringy, hygroscopic, sticks too well to smooth PEI; moderate cooling.

materials/pla.label: PLA
materials/pla.description: Easy, low-temp, loves cooling; overheats in enclosures.

materials/tpu.label: TPU (flexible)
materials/tpu.description: Slow, low retraction, very hygroscopic; direct drive strongly preferred.

mechanical-properties/part-orientation.label: Part orientation and anisotropy
mechanical-properties/part-orientation.description: FDM parts are direction-dependent because layer interfaces and raster paths create anisotropic strength and failure modes.

mechanical-properties/strength-and-testi.label: Mechanical strength and test interpretation
mechanical-properties/strength-and-testi.description: FDM mechanical performance depends on orientation, process history, geometry and conditioning; strength claims need reproducible test context.

slicer/flow-width-and-gcode.label: Slicer flow, width and firmware output
slicer/flow-width-and-gcode.description: PrusaSlicer and OrcaSlicer derive extrusion geometry and firmware commands from nozzle, layer, width, material and firmware context; profile values are not portable defaults.

slicer/profile-knowledge-map.label: PrusaSlicer profile to knowledge map
slicer/profile-knowledge-map.description: Map observable print symptoms and tuning concepts to effective PrusaSlicer profile keys, authority boundaries and diagnostic knowledge topics.

troubleshooting/diagnostic-matrix.label: FDM print defect diagnostic matrix
troubleshooting/diagnostic-matrix.description: A symptom-first diagnostic workflow that separates material, hardware, slicer and firmware hypotheses before changing settings.

tuning/build-surface.label: Build surface prep & handling
tuning/build-surface.description: Wash plates with dish soap, air dry, don't touch; scuff smooth PEI.

tuning/calibration-matrix.label: Calibration matrix and dependency order
tuning/calibration-matrix.description: A context-preserving calibration sequence that separates machine, firmware, material and slicer variables.

tuning/cooling-layer-times.label: Cooling and layer times
tuning/cooling-layer-times.description: Enough part cooling plus a minimum layer time so each layer solidifies before the next.

tuning/extruder-calibration.label: Extruder calibration (rotation_distance / e-steps)
tuning/extruder-calibration.description: Make 100 mm commanded equal 100 mm extruded; per-printer firmware value, not a slicer setting.

tuning/extrusion-multiplier.label: Extrusion multiplier (flow)
tuning/extrusion-multiplier.description: Per-filament flow tuned visually on top surfaces of 30x30x3 cubes; 2% then 0.5% steps.

tuning/first-layer-squish.label: First layer squish (Z offset)
tuning/first-layer-squish.description: Fine-tune nozzle-to-bed distance live with 0.01 mm babysteps using scattered test patches.

tuning/infill-perimeter-overlap.label: Infill/perimeter overlap
tuning/infill-perimeter-overlap.description: Pinholes where top infill meets perimeters after EM/PA are tuned — adjust overlap.

tuning/input-shaping.label: Input shaping
tuning/input-shaping.description: Reduce ringing by measuring printer resonances and selecting a shaper while controlling smoothing and acceleration.

tuning/max-volumetric-flow.label: Max volumetric flow
tuning/max-volumetric-flow.description: Find how many mm³/s the hotend can melt; cap it per filament so speed never outruns the hotend.

tuning/pressure-advance.label: Pressure advance / Linear advance
tuning/pressure-advance.description: Compensates extruder pressure lag on accel/decel; fixes corner bulges and line-start gaps. Per filament and per printer.

tuning/retraction.label: Retraction
tuning/retraction.description: Tune retraction length/speed only after PA, EM, moisture and mechanics are ruled out; small values for direct drive.

tuning/temperature-tuning.label: Temperature tuning
tuning/temperature-tuning.description: Establish a material- and hardware-specific temperature window before optimizing cooling, flow or retraction.

tuning/thermal-drift.label: Thermal drift (enclosed Klipper printers)
tuning/thermal-drift.description: Frame/gantry expansion shifts Z during the first ~hour of chamber heating; heat soak or compensate.

tuning/tuning-order.label: Tuning order
tuning/tuning-order.description: The order in which to calibrate a printer/filament so later steps aren't invalidated by earlier ones.
